text: I'm so happy today, I got the job I applied for!
I'm really sad. I just feel like nothing is going right.
I'm so anxious about the presentation tomorrow.
I am furious with my roommate; she ate my leftovers again.
I feel so lonely tonight. None of my friends replied to my messages.
I'm really grateful for the support my family gave me this week.
I'm exhausted. Three meetings back-to-back drained me.
